ops.title: Verify 5 unverified codex findings against registry.go (classify() cleanup, scratch guard, --ps prune TOCTOU, --await lock)
ops.description:
Surfaced 2026-07-25 as a byproduct of exercising the codex plugin's new shipped reply contract — the demo question was an unprompted review of `plugins/codex/registry.go`. These are RAW, UNVERIFIED gpt-5.6-sol finder output with no refuter pass run against them. Treat every severity as a claim, not a verdict; verify before acting.

Verbatim findings:

1. **blocker** — registry.go:167, :184, :247. `classify()` claims to be read-only but deletes `<reply>.tmp` using an unrestricted path read from `meta`; inspecting a corrupt or crafted lane can therefore delete any accessible `.tmp` file. Proposed fix: move cleanup out of `classify()` and only remove the recorded `cmd.ReplyTmp` after proving its canonical parent is the lane and holding its generation lock.

2. **blocker** — registry.go:57, :67, :552, :320, :350. The scratch guard is bypassable because the XDG-derived base is never checked, prohibited paths are compared lexically, and `--ps` follows symlinked directories before `RemoveAll`; a relative XDG path or symlink into a repository or `~/.claude` can be created in and pruned. Proposed fix: canonicalize the effective base and operands through their nearest existing ancestor, validate every base including XDG, refuse symlink traversal, and verify a prune target is a direct canonical descendant of the owned registry base.

3. **major** — registry.go:220, :237, :415, status.go:55. A run with `meta` but no `pid` or `status` stays `pending` forever, so a parent killed during the registration window makes `--watch` hang indefinitely even though `--await` gives up after ~15s. Proposed fix: apply the same bounded registration grace in `classify()` and transition expired entries to `died`/`failed`.

4. **blocker** — registry.go:348, :352, main.go:34, dispatch.go:224, :247. The claimed pruning TOCTOU closure is ineffective: while a lane is being reused, dispatch removes `meta` before replacing it, the second `classify()` returns terminal `no-run`, and `--ps` can delete the active lane. Proposed fix: coordinate pruning and dispatch with a stable lock outside the deletable directory, then verify the same generation and atomically quarantine the directory before deletion.

5. **major** — status.go:15, :23, registry.go:86. `--await` never invokes the scratch guard and creates `lane.lock` before verifying `meta`, so merely awaiting an arbitrary absolute repository or `~/.claude` directory writes into it. Proposed fix: resolve the lane directory and run the canonical scratch guard before acquiring or creating its lock.

Note the line numbers predate any renumbering from the `--lane`/`--schema` change landing in dispatch.go/main.go; registry.go and status.go were not touched by it.

ops.text: Each of the 5 findings has a refuter pass run against it and is marked confirmed, refuted, or revised
Every confirmed finding is either fixed with a regression test or has a recorded reason for deferring
The scratch-guard and prune-TOCTOU claims are checked against the existing lane.lock generation protocol before any redesign
